fact: Chapter 8 is titled 'Exercising The Mind For Mental Excellence', and its epigraph is Hebrews 5:14, 'But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil'
Your senses can be exercised
The FOUR ways to exercise the mind for mental excellence are research, meditation, the services of consultants, and insight-expectant prayer
Isaac Newton became a renowned success by exercising his mind to excellence
An apple dropped on Isaac Newton's head one day while he was sitting under an apple tree
Newton began wondering to himself 'Why did this thing fall? Why did it not stop in mid-air? What was pulling it?'
That was how Newton discovered the law of gravity, which has contributed in no small way to scientific and technological development
Research is the first way, and it means searching, searching and searching until you find what you are seeking
The instruction is 'Search, and if you can't find it, re-search, because it is there'
The author describes research as engaging in fact-finding study
The regenerated, anointed mind of Christ is a gift from God, but it is only a seed which must be nurtured until it begins to bring forth fruits
Daniel's understanding came alive and became more productive through his reading of books: the gift alone could not handle it, the books had to help the gift
Although uniquely gifted, the Hebrew boys still had a responsibility to nurture that seed unto fruit-bearing
Proverbs 27:17 is cited, 'iron sharpeneth iron': when you are searching or studying you are rubbing your ordinary mind with greater minds, and your dull mind is sharpened
Many have read things in the Bible but cannot grasp them, yet when they read other related books they understand what they hitherto could not grasp
No matter how gifted you are, how studious you are is what determines how colourful you will become mentally
Here the author says this explains why they say every genius is made up of 99 per cent perspiration and 1 per cent inspiration, because he has to keep at it
The gift is not enough, and this is where many Christians miss it
Paul was one of the most gifted men in the New Testament and he was a bookworm, cited as 1 Timothy 4:13, and he always had a notebook by him, cited as 2 Timothy 4:13

About to board a plane the author was told his briefcase had been left in the car, so he stopped and said he was not going anywhere without it, unable to imagine a whole week away without his personal study notes
Many read for pleasure, no wonder they constantly live under pressure; it is time to study for insight
The evidence of your studies must be seen around you, manifested in your freedom from sickness, sin, sorrow and suffering
Every committed reader is a potential leader
A leader is someone who sees ahead, who sees beyond what others are seeing and knows a little better than others, and because he has what others need they keep coming to him in search of it
The author calls Anthony Robbins 'the 700-in-one man'
The saying quoted is 'If wishes were horses, beggars would ride', and there are too many wishers in the Church doing nothing about their dreams
No one succeeds by accident, and Anthony Robbins is considered today as one of the most developed persons on the earth
David Yonggi Cho's wife piles up the books she thinks he should read by his bedside every week, and told him she was not forcing him to read them but that he would offend her if he did not
David Yonggi Cho pastors the largest congregation on the earth and has been at it for about 40 years, and the fire is still burning
Asked whether he crams scriptures, the author said 'No, I don't, I eat them!'
The more you read the more you will discover that you do not know: you read the same passage you have been reading for 20 years and still discover something you have never seen
1 Corinthians 8:2 is quoted: 'And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know'
Do not assume knowledge, consciously acquire it
The testimony is signed E.A.O. (Mrs.): she had been married for nine years but her marriage broke up because of her stealing habit, which started when she was a little girl
In the month of Visitation, Bishop Abioye recommended they read the book 'Dynamics Of Holiness', written by Bishop David Oyedepo
After reading that book the Holy Spirit opened her eyes, and she cursed herself to have leprosy if she ever stole again, and now she and her three children are living well
Paul charged Timothy to give attention to reading and to doctrine
Abraham Lincoln also said that the greatest thing in life is to keep your mind young
Meditation is the second way, defined here as giving mental focus to issues of interest, with the aim of enlightenment and illumination
Meditation was the greatest companion of the wisest man in Bible history, Solomon
Ecclesiastes 1:13-17 is quoted, including 'I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven' and 'I communed with mine own heart'
Solomon gave his heart, that is he was mentally focused, and he communed with his own heart, which is meditation
That was the secret behind the mental fertility that Solomon enjoyed: he was addicted to the art of meditation
The author thinks meditation is the missing asset in the Church today
So many are given to rigorous reading and studies, but very few take time to ponder the facts and issues involved
It is not enough to be a reader, you must also be a thinker
The questions to ask in meditation are 'What could be responsible for this?' and 'Why is it like this? Can't it be otherwise?'
If you have read and do not seem to have assimilated much, settle down and ponder over what you have read, grinding it mentally and believing there must be a solution
The services of consultants is the third way, and it was the practice of kings in Israel to engage the services of counsellors
Ahitophel was the think-tank of David's government, and later went with Absalom when he rebelled against his father
In those days the counsel of Ahitophel was as if a man took an oracle from the Lord, because he was deep
Moses would have died under a heavy load of responsibility if it were not for the counsel of Jethro, his father-in-law, whose godly counsel the author believes helped him to live long
Consultants can also be called counsellors: they are specialists in specific areas, and their mission is to enhance your understanding of issues in their fields of specialization
The author asks who can be a better consultant on church growth than David Yonggi Cho, the pastor of the largest church in the world

2 Samuel 16:23 is quoted: 'And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had inquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom'
Isaac Newton said 'If I have seen any farther, it is because I am standing on the shoulders of those who have gone before me'

It takes meekness to enjoy the ministry of counsellors, because a proud-hearted man will always have reasons why the things recommended will not work in his own case, or will say the counsellor is only lucky
Proverbs 11:14 says 'Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety'
Proverbs 15:22 says 'Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established'

Proverbs 19:20-21 says 'Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end. There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand'
Proverbs 20:18 says 'Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war'
Consultants may come your way on tapes or through books, while a few of them may come your way in person

When the author was privileged to be at Dr. Frederick K. C. Price's office and was taken around, his perspective changed, and that tour enhanced and boosted his understanding of what an office environment should be
When the author visited the Oral Roberts University he saw the classic business perspective in their operations and said to himself 'It can be done anywhere'
Psalm 92:14 is cited, that even in old age they shall still bring forth fruit, which is why the author wants productive longevity, not just to be alive but alive serving God
The author says when he sees someone who has stayed on successfully in ministry for 64 years he should learn from him how to keep alive and still be productive in old age
Prayer is the fourth way, specifically insight-expectant prayer, an avenue through which you can stir up the precious gift of a sound mind on your inside

In Daniel's days the king had a dream and forgot it, but the trouble of the dream remained with him, and he threatened to have all the wise men killed if they could not tell the dream and its interpretation
Daniel made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah, his companions, that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret
The secret was revealed unto Daniel in a night vision, and Daniel blessed the God of heaven, saying 'Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his'
Daniel's insight-expectant prayer is paraphrased as 'Lord, I don't know it, but I know You know it. God of heaven, show it now'
Jeremiah 33:3 is quoted: 'Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and show thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not'
James 1:5 is cited, that you can ask for wisdom from God if you lack it
When the devil came to snatch the author's little daughter he went up to his office, locked the doors and said 'There must be a way out'
Under one hour, three powerful scriptures with fire in them came alive in his spirit, and with them the sting of death was banished, death was swallowed up in victory, and Jesus was glorified
The instruction is to pray insight-expectant prayers, not just blank prayers

In that encounter God said 'I am He that was dead, and behold, I live forevermore, and it is in My hand that the keys of life and death are', and confirmed He would never favour His enemy with that key
You do not have to sleep like Daniel waiting for it to be revealed in a night vision; in fact the more awake you are, the more conscious and mentally alert you become

Insight-expectant prayer requires that you open your Bible and heart and say 'Lord, I know there's a way out here. These chains can't remain. No way! I am not born for captivity, I am a child of liberty!'
Until you put your mind to work, God will not mind you, and it is the exercise of the mind that produces excellence

E. W. Kenyon in his book 'Signposts On The Road to Success' said 'Make your brain work; it will sweat, but make it work. Then it will improve, it will develop, until you become the envy of those around you'
You have to make your brain work before it begins to work for you; it will not work on its own, as your conscious participation is required
